The '''Honor Clan''' was a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and warriors who worked together destabilize the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
